segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: In any event, an Ombudsman, Deputy Ombudsman or Special Prosecutor who has rendered at least seven years in

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim

segments.text: continuously in the Office of the Ombudsman as Ombudsman, Deputy Ombudsman

segments.text: or Special Prosecutor shall likewise be entitled to retire and receive during

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: savings, use of income, release of payment of retirement benefits and pension and

segments.text: retirement of the ombudsman, deputy ombudsman, and the special prosecutor

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: are indispensable safeguards that uphold the office's constitutionally guaranteed

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: independence and fiscal autonomy. It is earnestly hoped that the foregoing

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: provisions will be included in the general appropriations bill that will be

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: passed by the House of Representatives. So in closing, it cannot be denied that

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: the Philippines struggles every day with a problem of poverty and corruption.

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: Indeed, there is a positive association between corruption and poverty. Corruption

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: affects all of us, endangers our national life. It makes the poor poorer.

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: Reduce incidences of corruption increases government savings that can in

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: turn be used for poverty alleviation projects of this administration. Thus, the

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: office of the ombudsman earnestly hope that the House of Representatives in

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: considering the office of the ombudsman's budget for 2027 and that of

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: investigation and/or case build-up and enforcement of administrative and

segments.text: criminal liability to promote efficient service by the government to the people

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: through its proactive approaches. The office of the ombudsman in return commits that the budgetary

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: support it needs will not be spent aimlessly but will be utilized with the usual zeal and

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: dedication to enhance the confidence of the general public in the OMB as their watchdog,

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: mobilizer, official critic, and dispenser of justice because

segments.speaker: Office of the Ombudsman Director IV Christopher B. Lim
segments.text: the Filipino deserves no less. Thank you, Your Honors.

Umpisahan ko lang po muna siguro sa mga numero. Maaari ko po bang malaman: ano po ang current resolution and conviction rate ng ating opisina, and how does this compare to the previous years?

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: A.O. Bonoan will answer the question, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Yes. Assistant Ombudsman Bonoan, you are recognized.

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, sir. As of June 30,

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: 2026 the ombudsman reached a conviction rate of 65.52% in the Sandigan

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: Bayan. Now you may ask what measures were taken by the office to improve the

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: conviction rate in the past five years and we

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: actually have amended our rules of procedure to fast-track both the

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: preliminary investigation as well as the fact-finding initiatives of our office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So ibig sabihin po sa current year po mas mataas, nag-increase po. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: Yes ma'am. As 2025 ma'am our conviction rate in the Sandigan Bayan was 42% as

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: compared to this year's 65.52%. Thank you. Of this of this

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: of these cases how many corruption cases involving high-ranking officials

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: perhaps from salary grade 29 and above have been filed, resolved and

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: prosecuted?

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, um, I can, uh, I can answer your question, uh, by

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: distinguishing between our conviction rate in the Sandigan Bayan which

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: prosecutes high-ranking government officials ranked SG 27 and

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: above and lower courts which prosecute those 26 and below. So in 2025 the

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: conviction rate for the lower courts was 77.6% and as of June 30 this year it is

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: 64.91% as compared to as previously mentioned 42% in 2025 and

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: 65.52% in 2026 for the Sandigan Bayan. Thank you. Of this also how many have been

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: the subject of motu proprio investigation of the Ombudsman?

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, at present we don’t have the data to distinguish between motu

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: proprio and those that were filed with the office, but we can provide the

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: committee with the data.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. I would appreciate receiving that

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: information. Moving on po. What safeguards are in place to

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ensure that your office is insulated from political influence especially

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: in cases involving high-ranking officials?

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: Well, Your Honor, we really just do our job

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: and we heed our mandate as provided for in the Constitution,

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: which is to prosecute and investigate cases without fear and without favor, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, nakita ko po sa inyong capital outlay, you requested for an increase,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: but I also saw na meron kayong request for buildings and all that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Doon po ba sa capital outlay na increase ninyo, does it cover forensic digital purchase or procurement of tools?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Alam naman po natin kung gaano kahalaga ito para mas maging efficient yung inyong investigation.

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: To my understanding, Your Honor, yes. Yes, it does.

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: This is one of the initiatives of this new administration

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: to improve our capacities.

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: At least with regard to digitalization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, tungkol naman po sa regional reach ng Office of the Ombudsman,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ano po ang ano, how will your 2027 budget ensure that ma-expand natin po 'yung Ombudsman presence in the region

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: and it becomes accessible to the region?

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, actually, we are also looking at expanding

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: our investigations and our reach to BARMM,

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: to the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: And also, we have also requested budgets for our different regional offices

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: in Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao, as well as our satellite offices.

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: This budget will ensure their accessibility to the public

segments.speaker: Assistant Ombudsman Luis Gonzaga S. Bonoan, Jr.
segments.text: and continuous presence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yeah.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Do we have measurable indicators?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Perhaps mga numero na puwedeng magpatunay kung ilan ang nafa-file doon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: and how—gaano po ka-efficient 'yung ating regional offices?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: If you don't have the data right now,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: we also appreciate, um, receiving the same from you,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: katulad po ng kanina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano po. Um, ah, siguro po 'yung huling question ko na lang po kay Ombudsman Remulla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kamakailan po, um, naipahayag po ninyo at ako'y, uh,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ang kinatawang ito ay nalungkot

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: sa inyong pahayag na tama po ba na sinabi ninyo na wala na tayo—

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ang taong bayan ay wala nang maaasahan sa DPWH?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano po ba ang naging basehan ng statement po ninyo tungkol dito?

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ito po yung, salamat po sa tanong na yan,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: at maaari pong linawin ang konteksto ng aking pagsasabi niyan.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Pinag-uusapan po namin ang acquisition ng building, uh,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: ng NBI, kasi nga ako po yung dating Secretary of Justice

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: at kabisado ko po yung mga nagiging problema

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: sa pagpapagawa at pagtatalaga ng building ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: At ang isa pong naging problema na nakita kong matindi

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: ay yung Bureau of Immigration Building.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Inabot ho iyan halos ng walong bilyon at labindalawang taon,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: at hanggang ngayon, ngayon lang yata na tapos,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: yung driveway papunta po sa parking lot niya.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Yung driveway po niya, hindi ho kakasya.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ang kakasya lang po, Wigo.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Yung maliit po na sasakyan,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: pag may dala kayong pickup o SUV,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: hindi na po kakasya at hindi na po makakaparada sa taas.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ang problema po kasi,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: pag may government building na ginagawa,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: alam naman natin na hindi ho madali magpatayo ng building.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ito yung building, maraming pong cost overrun yan.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Pero pag ito po tinamaan ng graft

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: at tinamaan ng kickback mentality,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: talaga po mauubos pati yung building at mauubos po yung driveway.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ganoon kasama ang nakita kong pangyayari sa akin pong karanasan.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Dito po sa gobyerno, matagal na po ako sa gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Nagsimula po ako sa gobyerno 1992.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: At hindi naman po tuloy-tuloy, pero kadalasan po yan.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Hanggang 2026, halos sa gobyerno po ako.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Nakita ko lahat ng pangyayari sa paggastos ng pera ng bayan, at ang pagpapagawa ng building, isa po sa pinakanakakamuhi pong nangyayari sa atin.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Nakakaawa po 'yung ating mga—lagay natin sa paaralan pa lamang, ang paaralan po ng mga bata na kaunting-kaunti na ang ginawa, halos ang sama ng standard.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Pero itong mga building po na talagang kinakailangan ng gobyerno, talagang pagka nagpatayo po tayo at may [unclear] po sa pagpapatayo ng building, talaga pong naging substandard po talaga ang building.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ayun nga, example ho niyan, Immigration Building sa Macapagal Boulevard na dapat ho napakaganda kung titingnan natin ang naging gastos.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Halos walong bilyon ang aking pagkakaunawa. Pero kung titingnan ko ho at i-value ninyo ngayon,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: sa ngayong merkado, kung magkano po 'yung building na 'yon, baka hindi ho umabot ng two billion.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Kaya ang laki po ng ano, ng sayang eh.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Yun po, probably, it’s a point of emphasis na kinakailangan pong bantayan natin ang kaban ng bayan pagdating po sa pagpapatayo ng mga gusali.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Ombudsman. I share your observations and frustration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, given that po, ano po ang maaaring maitulong ng Ombudsman?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Given yung ganyang observation ninyo, upang linisin natin ang ahensyang ito ng katiwalian, without preempting whatever investigation you are currently doing right now, kung meron po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Para po, maging dekalidad yung ating mga infrastruktura at maibalik natin ang kumpiyansa ng taong bayan sa ahensya.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Unang-una siguro, kung talagang DPWH ang pag-uusapan, dapat ho ginagamit natin ang RDC.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Lahat po ng proyekto, dapat po nakaplano.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Hindi ho puwedeng, “Bigyan mo ako ng listahan ng gagawin mong kalye, tapos ako nang bahala.”

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Hindi po ganun eh.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Dapat ho yan nakaplano.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ang laki po ng gobyerno natin, marami tayong gobyerno na gumagawa ng trabaho para planuhin na maayos ang lahat.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Pero hindi po dapat ganun ah.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Dapat po talaga deliberate tayo at every step of the way sa paggastos ng pera ng bayan.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Yun nga 'yung nagiging problema natin,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: yung ating mga regional development plans, parang hindi ho nasunod nung bandang huli.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Itong mga nakaraang taon, lahat po naging flood-control budget na lang.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ang nangyari po sa budget natin, yung mga sabihin natin, flagship project ng Pangulo, nawala, naging unprogrammed fund na lang.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Yung po ating foreign-assisted project, naging unprogrammed na lang.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Kaya ang aming pong gagawin dito,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: sa aming opisina, magtatayo ho kami ng isang committee na babantayan lamang ang budget

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: at kung paano ho ginagastos ang pera ng bayan,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: na pwede na rin ho maging sumbungan ng taong bayan kung meron pong pagmamalabis.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: So, yung pagbabantay po ng budget, isa na ho sa direct functions namin, ang tingin ko na pinakamahalaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: I still have a little time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Let me just siguro state that,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ang kinatawang ito po ay kaisa ninyo sa inyong hangarin upang palakasin muli ang tiwala ng taong bayan sa ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: At alam po natin, nasabi nyo po sa inyong closing statement sa presentation, yung impact ng corruption.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And umaasa po kami na tunay na ang opisina ng Ombudsman ay ang magiging watchdog, mobilizer, official critic, and dispenser of justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: what do you think is the best solution to ensuring that corruption cases are given top priority by the justice system

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: na hindi na dapat lalampas sa limang taon yung buong paglilitis ng corruption case?

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ang una po kasi, ang ginagawa po namin ngayon kasi,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: nagke-case build-up po kami.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Tinaas po namin yung antas ng standard namin mula po sa probable cause

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: papuntang reasonable certainty of conviction.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ang teorya po diyan, pagka nakalap namin ng ebidensya, ito na, i-fight po namin sa korte.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ready na po kaming ilatag lahat ng aming ebidensya so we can rest our case immediately.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Kaya siguro, masanay po tayo ang ating judicial system sa continuous trial.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Kasi,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: yan po lang ang solusyon dyan eh.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Para wala na hong inordinate delay of justice.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Para wala na ho tayong 40-year wait.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Mas maganda ho kung maging mandatory yung continuous trial pagdating sa graft cases.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Para ho, mailatag lahat ng ebidensya at ma-rest namin ang case namin as early as possible.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ang problema kasi dyan, meron hong mga kaso na alam ko ha, may mga pending pa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Nag-represent kami ng evidence pero 15 years old lang yung kaso.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Meron pa ho kaming pending cases na hinihintay yung resulta hanggang sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Kaya, ang pagkahinog po ng kaso, marahil, pero ito pa'y paulit-ulit ko na pong kinausap ang ilang membro ng Supreme Court

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: na bigyan po ng atensyon yung mga kaso sa Sandigan Bayan.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Dapat ho mapansin talaga.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Sapagkat hindi ho ito pwede maging laruan ng abogado.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Ayun ang nangyayari kasi, yung pinakamagagaling na abogado po,

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: punta sa Sandiganbayan, basta sila yung maraming paraan.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Pero dapat ho dito talaga, matapos at matapos lahat ng paglatag na ebidensya

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: para wala na hong nakakalikot na record ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat po, Ombudsman Remulla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Ipapaabot din po namin sa judiciary ang inyong mga hinaing at saloobin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: And thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Congressman Chel Diokno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Ombudsman Remulla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Before we proceed, I'd like to acknowledge,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Representative Carlos Andes Loria.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you for coming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Now it is my honor as Vice Chairman to now yield the floor and the gavel

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: to the Honorable, no less than the Chairperson herself,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: of the Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We have here Chair Mika Suansing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you so much, Vice Chair Rufus Rodriguez.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ombudsman, I left you in very safe hands with Representative Rufus Rodriguez,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: of course, one of our legal luminaries here in Congress to defend the budget of the Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, alam ko po, kayang-kaya po yan ni Chair Rufus.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I just have a few questions from a budgetary standpoint.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: As you know, we're always in support of the Office of the Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Last year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we helped to work out the rental situation with the building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And then, with all the satellite offices,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we also supplied the necessary equipment and the additional manpower

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: to be able to augment the resources needed to facilitate those.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, this year, Ombudsman, I wanted to ask the same question to the Office of the Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I saw on your slides the list of requested additional funding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, may we request, Ombudsman, if we may request it in writing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: because we would have to submit it for the deliberation of the Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: which is one of our main reforms since last year, the Committee on Appropriations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: wherein we make sure all the institutional amendments requested to the Committee on Appropriations

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: are deliberated on openly to be shown to the public.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I saw here po additional confidential funds, Ombudsman marshal positions, motor vehicles, and the purchase of the new office building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We wanted to make sure, given the very important mandate that the Office of the Ombudsman has,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we want to make sure that we give you the resources to be able to perform all of the very important work that you are doing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, may we request, Ombudsman, when you submit the letter, is it okay if we request for a prioritization?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We would also know if we're able to find the additional fiscal space, which ones we would prioritize first.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. We will comply, Your Honor. We will comply as soon as possible.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, and then with regard to the requested special provision, we're always in support of that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It was there in the 2026 GAAA as well, in terms of the requested special provision.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, um,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We'll coordinate na lang po as we fine-tune the GAB for 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that the proper wording, the necessary wording is reflected as such in the GAB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, yun lang naman po. I don't have questions naman po, Chair Rufus.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It's really more of I wanted to make sure to give the assurance to the Office of the Ombudsman, to Ombudsman Boying,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that we are very much in support of the budget of the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Office of the Ombudsman, and we are very much appreciative, and we commend the hard work and all the good work that the Office of the Ombudsman is doing for our country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, to show our appreciation, the best that we could do is to be able to make sure to give you the resources that you need to perform your mandate better.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, we'll coordinate na lang po, Ombudsman, with regard to the list of requested amendments,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: so that, if possible po, as soon as possible, given that we are, um, convening the BAR C in a week or so,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: para po maipasok po natin sa deliberations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much po.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair, and thank you for that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Atty. Diokno would like to be recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: May isa lang pong pahabol, if I may, Madam Chair, to the office—to Ombudsman Remulla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Um, I understand that part of the function of the Office of the Ombudsman is also to monitor impeachment proceedings, uh, in case there are any investigations or prosecutions that should come after kapag may lumitaw na mga ebidensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: I also would like to say that earlier I saw your budget proposal for confidential funds, which is only at the amount of 55 million or more or less in that area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: And sa palagay ko, kayo yung nangangailangan ng mas malalaking confidential funds kaysa sa yung mga ibang mga ahensya na tinututukan natin doon sa kaso ng impeachment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: My question is, uh, may I know if the—your office is presently monitoring the, uh, status of the testimonies and evidence being presented, especially with respect to the confidential funds, for possible, um, violations that may be investigated after?

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: It is being monitored by our office, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin C. Remulla
segments.text: There is—there is an active unit monitoring the goings-on at the impeachment, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Thank you so much for that, because we do have some concerns about, um, accountability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: That's precisely why we have the impeachment process.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel Tadeo "Chel" I. Diokno
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Chair. Maraming salamat, Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you very much. May I now reassume as Vice Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because there are no more interpellators, and so therefore this Chair, this Vice Chair, now is ready to accept a motion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: to terminate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Uh, Mr. Chair, may I move that we terminate the budget briefing of the Office of the Ombudsman?

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: I so move.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Is there any second motion?

segments.speaker: Committee member
segments.text: Second.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Moved and seconded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We now terminate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Congratulations, Ombudsman Remulla, and we thank you for coming and presenting your budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And so we thank also our members for your active participation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The briefing is now terminated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The committee proceedings—just an announcement—the committee proceedings are hereby suspended and will resume at 3 p.m.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: for the Commission on Audit

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: budget briefing. Thank you.
